instruction: Enable the parallel downloading feature in Chrome to speed up downloads by splitting them into multiple connections.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to enable the parallel downloading experiment in Chrome by navigating to chrome://flags and enabling the 'Parallel downloading' flag. The evaluator checks if 'enable-parallel-downloading' is present in the enabled experiments list. Similar difficulty to the original task which requires disabling UI refresh experiments.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome's Local State file from platform-specific location and extracts enabled_labs_experiments array
Getter correctly strips @suffix from experiment names (experiments stored as 'name@version' format)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('experiment_name') as the rules dict is passed directly by get_rule()
Metric uses appropriate exact string matching for experiment flag verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling parallel downloading, evaluator checks for 'enable-parallel-downloading' flag
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome with 3-second sleep to ensure Local State file is written to disk
Expected value 'enable-parallel-downloading' is the correct internal Chrome flag name
Edge cases properly handled: non-list results, file read errors, missing experiment names all return appropriate values
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts list of experiments -> metric checks if expected experiment is present
